## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

## Model Links

**Input Assets**
- [transparent_rgb_gaming_mouse.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/transparent_rgb_gaming_mouse.png) — required workflow input (`input/transparent_rgb_gaming_mouse.png`)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 8 steps:  [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)
-  4 steps: [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

【人物与参考图】
成年女性主角。参考图锁定：明亮居家办公室场景（白色电脑桌、双显示器、键盘、黑色塔式主机、置物架手办、左侧橙色墙、右侧白窗帘暖光、窗台粉色动漫立牌、黑色人体工学电竞椅）、第一人称POV构图、女主形象与初始服装。全程同一个女主：不换脸、不变年龄、不变脸型、不变身材比例、不变发型。
【画面风格】
超真实、电影级真人AI视频。第一人称POV固定机位，仅极轻微自然手持晃动，一镜到底，不切镜、不推拉摇移、不变焦。女主坐在画面中央偏左的电竞椅上，拍摄者右手举着iPhone位于画面右侧前景。真实室内光影与皮肤、头发、衣料质感。画面中不出现任何文字、字幕、图标、Logo、水印。
【换装机制】
女主全程坐在电竞椅上翘腿，不站起、不离画。拍摄者只有右手和声音入镜，绝不露脸。换装通过"像素马赛克故障转场"在画面内完成：低分辨率彩色像素块从女主腿部出现并向上蔓延，像马赛克拼图一样逐块把旧衣服替换成新衣服，持续约2秒，带轻微电子故障感。转场只作用于衣服：脸、发型、坐姿全程不变。第一次换装只换连衣裙，头上不出现任何饰品；兔耳只在第二次换装时才出现。
【服装】
初始：军绿色缎面吊带连衣裙、红色美甲、银色细项链。
第一套：红白格纹女仆装，抹胸式短裙、白色围裙、白色荷叶边、胸前白色猫咪图案配红色蝴蝶结、黑色玛丽珍鞋。
第二套：黑色亮片抹胸兔女郎装、白色衬衫领、黑色领结、漆皮黑色兔耳发箍、腰侧白色绒球尾巴、黑色丝袜、黑色高跟鞋。
【时间轴（全片约15秒）】
00:00–00:01 女主低头玩自己的手机，翘腿，神情专注放松。
00:01–00:03 右手将iPhone举入画面右侧，屏幕是粉色背景购物App，显示红白格纹女仆装的商品大图和一个红色购买按钮，界面上没有文字段落。男声画外：「AI帮我把她的衣服换成这套。」拇指点击红色按钮。
00:03–00:05 像素马赛克转场①：色块从她腿部向上蔓延，连衣裙逐块替换为红色女仆装，手机屏幕同步出现黑色玛丽珍鞋的商品图。转场结束她仍低头看手机，浑然不觉。
00:05–00:07 她低头发现衣服变了，愣住，随即惊讶地抬头瞪向镜头；女声：「唉什么情况？」
00:07–00:09 她举起一只手对着镜头做停止手势，嘟嘴；女声：「哎呀不要。」
00:09–00:10.5 手机屏幕切换为黑色兔女郎套装的商品大图；男声画外：「你穿一下。」
00:10.5–00:12.5 像素马赛克转场②：色块再次从腿部蔓延，女仆装逐块替换为黑色兔女郎装，漆皮兔耳在她头顶出现；她举着抗议的手僵在半空。
00:12.5–00:15 她放下手，坐回椅背翘腿，对镜头傲娇地嘟嘴；女声娇嗔：「讨厌啦～」保持眼神交流，画面自然结束。
【音频】
真实自然的中文女声，年轻、自然、略带傲娇，口型与台词精确同步。男声成熟、简短，始终为画外音。台词共五句，按时间轴依次出现，不提前、不重复、绝不同时说话。环境音：空调低鸣、手机点击声；两次转场配轻微电子故障音；无背景音乐。
【表演】
现实中的成年女性，不是动漫角色，不夸张卖萌。情绪递进：专注→浑然不觉→惊讶→抗议→无奈傲娇。表情、眨眼、呼吸、手部动作自然真实。
【画面一致性】
同一办公室场景贯穿全片：桌面物品、显示器、主机、手办、橙色墙、窗帘、窗台立牌、电竞椅位置不变；灯光不变；机位透视不变；不切镜。手机屏幕内容与身上服装严格对应：屏幕显示女仆装时她穿初始装，转场后穿女仆装；屏幕显示兔女郎装时她穿女仆装，转场后穿兔女郎装。
